title: Precondition for the Savitch program
statement: For every natural number $E$, Boolean word $x$, and abstract configuration $a$ with eighteen registers and labels from the program $A(E)$, the precondition of $A(E)$ holds for $a$ and input $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is an abstract configuration with eighteen natural-number registers and labels in the state type of $A(E)$
replaced:
For every natural number $E$, oracle on four deciders and Boolean-string inputs, input
string $x$, and machine configuration $a$, the configuration satisfies the program
precondition for the machine program determined by $E$ and input $x$.
